blocker_summary_line: Class SD: the draft states the ENBW*T = 1/2 equality case as holding iff the filter is a POSITIVE multiple of the boxcar (abstract L34-36 and body L222-223). enbw_eq_half_iff_boxcar carries no positivity: the multiplier is the filter's own DC average (int h)/T with only (int h) != 0 as a binder, so h = -boxcar T saturates the floor as a NEGATIVE multiple and refutes the forward direction as written.
